description: Rupture d’une digue d’un bassin de lagunage de la sucrerie Tereos le 9 avril 2020 à Thun-Saint-Martin (59) et pollution de l’Escaut is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Transition écologique. The accident that occurred on the night of 9 to 10 April 2020 in Thun-Saint-Martin (59) causing the break of the dike in the Iwuy canal basin of the Tereos sugar factory is distinguished by the extent of the pollution it has generated. Coverage: Ministère de la Transition écologique. The portal shows the English title as "Breaking of a dyke in a lagoon basin of the Tereos sugar factory on 9 April 2020 in Thun-Saint-Martin (59) and pollution" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de la Transition écologique. Its keywords include pollution-industrielle, observation-de-la-terre-et-environnement, legislation-horizontale, hvd, pollution, environnement. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
